name: m41b_oger_width_v2
question: Re-test of the ogerpon width replication on a panel with HEADROOM. The first attempt (14a4e4d20d5254b4) put 2 of 3 cells at ceiling -- ogerpon beats grim 0.99 and dragapult 0.98 -- so no gain could appear there. This panel was chosen by screening every available bed against the CONTROL (not the arm) at n=400 and keeping only cells in the 0.35-0.80 band: wall 0.435, bc_top 0.568, archaludon 0.743. Everything else on the roster reads 0.93-0.99 against this deck and is excluded as unmeasurable.
